description: Puerto Rico's dive sites as 787daily's diving hub lists them (/water/diving/), from the shops, dive logs and agencies: depth in feet and metres, shore or boat entry, the certification a source names, walls, reefs, wrecks and caverns, current, visibility, hazards, the reserve a site lies in and its rules, and the shops that dive it (with their standing). Filter by region (north, northwest, west, desecheo, mona, southwest, south, east, culebra, vieques, or a town), maxDepthFt (sites whose published maximum is within it), level (the diver's card: dsd, ow, advanced, tech; dsd = no card), entry, reserve or feature. Sites that pass the other filters but publish no depth or name no level come back by name in depthNotPublished / levelNotStated. Never present a depth or a level as a guarantee; cite the site's url.

level.description: The diver's certification: dsd (none, Discover Scuba), ow, advanced, tech

maxDepthFt.description: The deepest the diver will go, in feet

region.description: A dive region id or label, or a town, e.g. 'southwest', 'Culebra', 'Aguadilla'

reserve.description: true: sites inside a marine reserve; false: outside

name: find_dive_sites
title: Dive sites in Puerto Rico
